Hi Claire / Mike —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap from our side: you want a focused technical session that walks your infra and ML teams through performance and networking requirements, quantization/accuracy tradeoffs for your workloads, and a brief ops runbook for deployment and rollback.

Proposed next step: a 60–90 minute deep-dive with our ML infra engineers + solutions team. Goals for the session:
- Alignment on SLA / latency targets and current model footprints
- Walkthrough of Redwood serving runtime and caching/kv strategies that matter for your traffic patterns
- Concrete preflight checklist for a pilot (required cloud config, KMS, logging/audit capture)

Available windows (all PT):
- Tue Sep 5: 09:00–10:30 or 13:00–14:30
- Wed Sep 6: 10:00–11:30
- Fri Sep 8: 08:30–10:00

Please share which slot works, and who from your side will join (title + role). I attached a short agenda draft (redwood-tdx-agenda-v1.pdf) and a mutual action plan template to capture owners.

Attendees we plan to include from Redwood: Jordan (SE), Grace (Product), Ben (Solutions), Marcus (Infra). If you want additional deep-dive on inference kernels we can add a backend engineer.

Next steps: pick a slot, share attendee list, and we’ll send a calendar invite with a final agenda + prep asks.

Best,
Jordan Blake
